mapper.insert: insert into bills(amount, incomeexpenditure, createTime, updatedTime, typeid, invoices, userid, remark, status) values (#{amount}, #{incomeexpenditure}, #{createTime}, #{updatedTime}, #{typeid}, #{invoices}, #{userId}, #{remark}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN Incomeexpenditure = '收入' THEN CAST(amount AS DECIMAL) WHEN Incomeexpenditure = '支出' THEN -CAST(amount AS DECIMAL) END), 0) AS total_assets, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE (createTime) = CURRENT_DATE AND Incomeexpenditure = '收入' THEN CAST(amount AS DECIMAL) END), 0) AS today_income, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE (createTime) = CURRENT_DATE AND Incomeexpenditure = '支出' THEN CAST(amount AS DECIMAL) END), 0) AS today_expense, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(createTime, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') AND Incomeexpenditure = '收入' THEN CAST(amount AS DECIMAL) END), 0) AS monthly_income, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(createTime, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') AND Incomeexpenditure = '支出' THEN CAST(amount AS DECIMAL) END), 0) AS monthly_expense FROM bills

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(createTime, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(IF(Incomeexpenditure='收入', CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(10,2)), 0)) AS income, SUM(IF(Incomeexpenditure='支出', CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(10,2)), 0)) AS expense, SUM(IF(Incomeexpenditure='收入', CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(10,2)), -CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(10,2)))) AS balance FROM bills GROUP BY month ORDER BY month DESC;
